game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Characteristics and limits
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing, a rope bridge over a pit: the spelunker must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing: a rope bridge over a pit
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 4: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Characteristics and limits.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Counter Conveyor' (Week 4 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lantern Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
